lines: Carry out the design and execution of ground soil
improvement to achieve the required bearing pressure of
subsoil; including earthwork support where required, survey
and setting out, laboratory soil tests, authority approvals and
all incidental works to complete.
The contractor shall also provide necessary specifications
associated with the design to ensure full compliance with the
performance criteria stipulated in the issued drawings and
project requirements.
